description: List the users in the application. Supports filtering by activity, nickname, ids, and metadata. Platform API: GET /users. Returns { users[], next }.

active_mode.description: Filter by activation state. Default activated.

metadatakey.description: Metadata key to filter on (pair with metadatavalues_in).

token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's `next`.

user_ids.description: Comma-separated user ids to fetch specific users.

name: sendbird_list_users
title: List users
